title: extract_rust_crate validation gate misses test-target breakage (cargo check skips --all-targets)
wanted_capability: The extract_rust_crate compound run should validate with `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` (or run the test build) so cross-crate cfg(test) breakage is caught inside the transaction. Peeling util into bbox-util passed the run's `cargo check --workspace` gate but broke the root crate's test build: TestEnvGuard was #[cfg(test)]-gated, and cfg(test) is false when the new crate compiles as a dependency of the consumer's test build. The run reported success; the breakage only surfaced at the nextest gate after the transaction had committed its writes. A leftover-warning heuristic flagging #[cfg(test)] items in moved module files (same class as the existing env!(CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR) re-rooting warning) would also help.
missing_primitive: extract_rust_crate expansion: --all-targets on its cargo check gate, or a cfg(test)-item leftover warning in extract_rust_crate_scaffold
fallback_used: Ran cargo nextest run --workspace manually after the run completed; un-gated the cfg(test) items in the peeled crate (commit f0f9aac5) following the TEST_ENV_LOCK precedent.
